title: Derived tensor-Hom comparison for a perfect complex
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let K be a perfect complex [def-pc-perfect-complex] in D_QCoh(O_X) [def-pc-derived-category], and let M be a quasi-coherent complex. Define K^\vee := R\mathcal Hom_{O_X}(K,O_X). Then K^\vee is a perfect complex in D_QCoh(O_X). The canonical global map M\otimes^L K^\vee \longrightarrow R\mathcal Hom_{O_X}(K,M) induced by evaluation is an isomorphism, and the canonical bidual map K\longrightarrow R\mathcal Hom_{O_X}(K^\vee,O_X) is an isomorphism. Let \epsilon:K^\vee\otimes^L K\to O_X be the evaluation map and \eta:O_X\to K\otimes^L K^\vee the map corresponding to \mathrm{id}_K under the isomorphism K\otimes^L K^\vee\cong R\mathcal Hom_{O_X}(K,K) (the case M=K); then (\epsilon,\eta) satisfy the two zig-zag identities (1_K\otimes\epsilon)\circ(\eta\otimes 1_K)=\mathrm{id}_K and (\epsilon\otimes 1_{K^\vee})\circ(1_{K^\vee}\otimes\eta)=\mathrm{id}_{K^\vee}, so (K,K^\vee,\epsilon,\eta) is an exact pairing in D_QCoh(O_X) with its derived tensor product. For every morphism g:X'\to X [def-pc-derived-pullback], the canonical base-change map Lg^*K^\vee \longrightarrow R\mathcal Hom_{O_{X'}}(Lg^*K,O_{X'}) is an isomorphism.
